# Ravenwood UI

Personal shadcn/ui registry and preview. Radix primitives, style name radix-nova. Dark default, light paper theme. Not a second primitive set.

Repo: https://github.com/raythurman2386/ravenwood-ui
Registry catalog: registry.json at the repo root.
Namespace: @ravenwood -> https://raw.githubusercontent.com/raythurman2386/ravenwood-ui/main/public/r/{name}.json

## Install

npx shadcn@latest init --template next --base radix --name my-app --yes raythurman2386/ravenwood-ui/index
npx shadcn@latest add @ravenwood/button

GitHub address form is owner/repo/item. index is the registry:base item (tokens, Fraunces, Figtree, radix-nova, @ravenwood namespace). theme is registry:style and overlays tokens on an existing shadcn app. A single component with no namespace: npx shadcn@latest add raythurman2386/ravenwood-ui/button

Same-repo registryDependencies use raythurman2386/ravenwood-ui/<item>. A bare name installs official shadcn.

## Tokens

Source: app/globals.css. Mirrored on registry items theme and index.
Dark is default (html.dark, next-themes defaultTheme dark, enableSystem false). Light tokens on :root.

--background dark hsl(110 9% 4.7%) bark
--card dark hsl(120 8% 9%) wood panel
--foreground dark hsl(40 38% 92%) parchment
--primary dark hsl(158 40% 32%) canopy
--ring dark hsl(40 46% 58%) lantern brass focus ring
--destructive dark hsl(8 42% 62%) dried blood
--moss --lantern --rust plus foregrounds
--radius 0.45rem
--font-serif Fraunces, headings and .font-display
--font-sans Figtree
--ease-enter cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)
--ease-exit cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 1, 1)
--ease-press cubic-bezier(0, 0, 0.2, 1)
--ease-snap cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1)
--ease-ground aliases enter
Named intents (lib/motion.ts): snap 110ms, ui 180ms, overlay 200ms (exit 160ms), layout 220ms, gentle 220ms (rare). Cap 220ms.
Press squash scale(0.98). Hover is color and border. Press scale is 0.98.
Ask: what does this motion communicate? If not press, origin, hierarchy, or continuity, delete it.
Ban: transition-all; linear UI easing; ease-in-out default; hover scale > 1.02; bounce/wiggle/ping/pulse chrome; idle loops; staggered first-paint paragraphs; 400ms+ functional; Lottie/Rive chrome loops; drifting glow orbs; layout reflow while reading.
prefers-reduced-motion and .motion-reduce zero travel (translate/scale/rotate), not only duration.
Grain on body only, feColorMatrix alpha 0.06. .lucide stroke-width 1.75. Controls are flat. ForestCard keeps one focus-ring hairline. Do not repeat that rail on alerts, inputs, dialogs, or empty states.

## Files

components/ui/* primitives, one copy, registry paths point here
registry/ravenwood/* signature sources; install target components/ravenwood/<name>.tsx
hooks/use-mobile.ts
lib/utils.ts re-exports cn
lib/catalog.ts docs index and consumer usage snippets
components/docs/showcase.tsx live examples
lib/motion.ts named intents (snap, ui, overlay, layout, gentle)
app/(site) home, docs, /motion
app/kitchen runs desk
app/r/[name] serves public/r JSON

Signature pieces: raven-mark, forest-card, grove-alert (moss|lantern|rust), hollow-input, raven-empty-state, page-shell (Next.js, uses sidebar), kbd, status-dot, metric, data-list, section-header, callout, copy-button, spinner, progress, slider, toggle, toggle-group, timeline, log-line, item, banner, empty-panel, field, shortcut-hint.

Imports in registry files: cn from "cn", primitives from "radix-ui". Preview may import @/registry/ravenwood. Consumer snippets import @/components/ravenwood.

## Add a component

Match button, card, input, dialog, sidebar. Register it in registry.json. GitHub addresses for Ravenwood deps. Catalog entry plus showcase case. pnpm registry:validate && pnpm registry:build && pnpm typecheck.

## Commands

pnpm dev
pnpm typecheck
pnpm registry:validate
pnpm registry:build
pnpm build
